text:
Maya Patel: Quick note from UX review: prioritize keyboard-first interactions for the compare table before the next release. Key topics: keyboard reorder, pin modal accessibility, and dense badge behavior. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/mockups/compare-keyboard-2319.png
Jon Reyes: Agreed. I prototyped keyboard reorder: focus a chip, then press Alt+ArrowLeft/Right to move. Works well in the demo.
Priya Desai: Nice. Can we use aria-live polite to announce "Filter order updated" after the move? Also add a short visible hint for first-time users.
Kara Gomez: Yes to aria-live. For pinning: when user pins a version from compare, open a small confirmation modal that explains scope ("Pin this version model-wide?"), includes keyboard focus trap, and allows esc to cancel. The modal must expose role=dialog and label by heading.
Maya Patel: Modal microcopy: heading "Pin version" and body "Lock model to version vX.Y? This applies to all compare views unless unpinned." Primary action label: "Pin model". Secondary: "Cancel".
Jon Reyes: Implementation note: modal should set inert on the background to prevent accidental interactions. We'll reuse our modal component.
Priya Desai: Performance badges in dense rows are tricky. Recommendation: show a single compact badge showing p95 and a chevron for details. On focus open an inline panel with p50/p95/p99 and a short text "Compared to baseline (7d)". Avoid hover-only reveals.
Kara Gomez: Contrast check: compact badge background must meet 3:1 against text. Also ensure the chevron icon has an accessible name, e.g., "Show perf details".
frontend-bot: Preview branch available at https://staging.redwood.io/compare/keyboard-a11y with keyboard reorder and pin modal implemented.
Maya Patel: Action items:
- Jon to push reorder accessibility tweaks and announce copy (owner: Jon, due Thu)
- Priya to write modal microcopy and small hint for first-time users (owner: Priya, due Wed)
- Kara to run quick contrast & screenreader check once preview is live (owner: Kara, due Fri)
- Frontend to attach PR to RD-INF-4999 when ready (owner: Frontend team)
Maya Patel: Thanks team ":heart:"
